column1: Note: every alternative rule was applied to the full cohort with the eligibility gate re-anchored at that rule's cutoff. An earlier version of this table held the eligibility gate at the primary near-zero threshold (0.0202 for scaffold and external DILIst, 0.0053 for temporal, 0.0058 for cluster-out). Because that value lies below the calibrated-score range of every cohort, the eligible subset was empty in external DILIst and cluster-out and the low-score count was zero for every rule by construction. Counts here supersede that version. The th_sens95 row for HistGB is the operative low-risk rule used in the primary analysis; every other row is a sensitivity variant.
